entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Kasana–Luweero is a suffragan diocese of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kampala in Uganda. The diocese serves the Catholic faithful in the cities of Kasana and Luweero and covers an area of 8,539 square kilometres (3,297 sq mi).
